layers.command: rg -n 'schema_id:\s*ip' registry/content-schema.yaml && rg -n 'root:\s*content/ips/\{ip_id\}/' registry/content-schema.yaml && test -f contracts/ip.schema.yaml

tc_results.command: rg -n 'schema_id:\s*ip' registry/content-schema.yaml && rg -n 'root:\s*content/ips/\{ip_id\}/' registry/content-schema.yaml && test -f contracts/ip.schema.yaml
for f in ip_id title kind status canon_revision publish_identity_ref; do rg -q "$f" contracts/ip.schema.yaml||exit 1; done
for c in master-content storyworld campaign narrative-episode; do rg -q 'imports' contracts/$c.schema.yaml||exit 1; done
for rc in ip_not_found ip_unfrozen asset_missing revision_mismatch; do rg -q "$rc" scripts/check_ip_model.sh||exit 1; done
! rg -n 'fallback.*redescrib|静默.*本地重描述' scripts/check_ip_model.sh || rg -n '禁止' scripts/check_ip_model.sh
export PRISM_HOME=$(pwd); bash scripts/check_prism_project_docs.sh --init-shape /tmp/prism-ipm-shape-x 2>/dev/null; rg -n 'ips' scripts/check_prism_project_docs.sh

beacon doctor verify-truth-integrity prism-ip-schema-v1 --project-root . --version v0.0.1 --mode block --json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); exit(0 if d.get('result',{}).get('blocked') in (False,None) and d.get('result',{}).get('closure_contract',{}).get('closure_allowed') else 1)"
rg -n 'import 引用 .draft. 或 .archived. 状态的 IP' docs/beacon/v0.0.1/features/prism-ip-schema-v1/truth.md
rg -n '已钉 revision 的 import 在源 revision 变更后静默改引用' docs/beacon/v0.0.1/features/prism-ip-schema-v1/truth.md
